name: functions
description: Five-orites Scoop — server-authoritative stock decrement and order pricing
//: Deployed as its own unit: Firebase builds and runs this package separately from the Angular app, so it carries its own package.json, its own node_modules and its own copy of every business rule it has to enforce. Nothing in src/ is importable at runtime from here.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
